messages:
leah: FYI getting a weird SAML/OIDC cascade after the IdP rotated JWKs. Several SCIM creates are returning 409s and then our provisioning worker retries and hits KMS rate-limit errors when rewrapping mapping keys. Root logs show SAML signature verify failures earlier.

mike: timeline? did the IdP publish new JWKS without TTL overlap?

leah: IdP pushed keys at 2026-04-02T03:10Z. Our SAML SP cache TTL is 300s, but some app servers still used old keys and failed signature verification ~03:11-03:14. SCIM connector fell back to admin-impersonation path which triggered extra create attempts.

nora: paste the errors?

leah: logs (redacted):
```
2026-04-02T03:11:02Z WARN  saml-verify idp=corp-sso err="signature verification failed: unknown kid" req=xyz
2026-04-02T03:11:05Z ERROR scim-provisioner err="create user: 409 Conflict" user_extid=alice@example.com
2026-04-02T03:11:07Z ERROR kms rewrap err="ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded" principal=arn:aws:sts::444444444444:assumed-role/scim-role
```

iden-bot: ALERT: SAML_KID_MISMATCH detected for corp-sso (count=14)

mike: so two problems: 1) JWK rotation caused transient signature mismatches, 2) fallback retry logic produced duplicate create attempts and aggressive rewraps hitting KMS throttle.

nora: mitigation: 1) add a short-circuit to dedupe concurrent SCIM create retries for same extId for 5 minutes, 2) increase rewrap backoff and batch rewraps, 3) coordinate with IdP to publish JWKS with overlap or use kid+cache-bust.

leah: I asked IdP team to confirm their rotation policy; they rolled forward a fix to publish old key with 'use' field for 2m overlap. They also agreed to add a rotation event webhook to our infra.

ops: I've paused aggressive rewrap job and bumped KMS quotas where possible. Also set temporary 1-minute lock in provisioning worker for identical extIds.

mike: for audit: capture CloudTrail calls for GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt and SAML assertions around 03:08-03:20 and upload to incidents bucket. We need to note that no CMK compromise is suspected; this is operational.

nora: opened INC-2026-810 and uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-810-idp-jwk-sync. Postmortem action items: - add JWKS rotation validation in onboarding, - extend SP cache grace to 600s or honor IdP overlap header, - add dedupe lock for SCIM create path, - implement batched rewrap with jitter.

leah: quick query showed 12 half-created mappings: `SELECT extid,status FROM scim_mappings WHERE status='creating' AND created_at > '2026-04-02T03:00:00Z'`. I reconciled 9, left 3 for the migration job.

mike: recommend not rotating CMK; do per-record rewrap if you must. Rewrap job scheduled next low-traffic window.

ops: scheduling temporary alert threshold for SAML_KID_MISMATCH spikes and setting runbook link. Closing emergency once CloudTrail and IdP approval notes are attached to INC-2026-810.

leah: added timeline and IdP ack. Marking resolved pending follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
